shortDescription.default: Team vacations and absences on a month calendar

longDescription.default: Shows team vacations and absences from a SharePoint list on a month calendar, with multi-day bars, lane stacking for overlaps, an 'Out this week' strip and a per-person details panel with Email and Teams links. Reads a plain list and needs no Microsoft Graph permissions.
